# Bosun

> GitOps for Docker Compose on bare metal. "Helm for home."

Bosun is a single-binary CLI tool that brings GitOps workflows to homelab Docker Compose deployments. Push to git, bosun receives orders, containers deploy automatically. No Kubernetes required.

## Nautical Theme

Everything uses nautical/Below Deck terminology:
- **Bosun** - CLI tool and orchestrator (receives orders, deploys containers)
- **Manifest** - Service definitions (crew manifest)
- **Provisions** - Reusable config templates (supplies stocked aboard)
- **Captain** - GitHub (gives orders)
- **Radio** - Webhook/tunnel (Tailscale Funnel or Cloudflare Tunnel)
- **Crew** - Containers
- **Yacht** - Server/host running Docker Compose

## Key Commands

### Setup & Diagnostics
- `bosun init` - Interactive setup wizard
- `bosun doctor` - Pre-flight checks
- `bosun status` - Health dashboard
- `bosun update` - Install the latest stable release only after verifying the selected compressed archive against the same release's `checksums.txt`; missing or invalid checksum data fails closed without replacing the executable
- `bosun update --check` - Inspect same-release archive and checksum asset metadata without downloading either asset

### Daemon (GitOps)
- `bosun daemon` - Run the GitOps daemon
- `bosun trigger` - Trigger reconciliation
- `bosun reconcile` - One-shot GitOps workflow
- `bosun drift` - Show drift between declared and actual state
- `bosun drift --live` - Fresh drift check against Docker

### Docker Management
- `bosun yacht up/down/restart/status` - Manage Docker Compose services
- `bosun crew list/logs/inspect/restart` - Manage individual containers

### Manifest & Provisioning
- `bosun provision [stack]` - Render manifest to compose/traefik/gatus configs
- `bosun provisions` - List available provisions
- `bosun create <template> <name>` - Scaffold new service
- `bosun lint` - Validate manifests

## Architecture

```
git push -> webhook/poll -> clone repo -> decrypt secrets (SOPS) ->
template configs (Go text/template + Sprig) -> deploy to target ->
docker compose up -> post-deploy drift verification
```

The daemon provides:
- Unix socket API at `/var/run/bosun.sock`
- Unix socket permissions default to `0660`; Bosun applies the configured mode behind a private staging directory and atomically publishes the restricted socket, without a process-global umask change or a permissive final-path window. Stale symlinks/non-sockets and replacement entries are never removed as owned sockets. Linux mutating requests also require a peer UID matching the daemon owner or `BOSUN_SOCKET_ALLOWED_UIDS`; missing credentials fail closed unless `BOSUN_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_SOCKET=true` explicitly opts out
- All daemon HTTP transports (webhook, Unix socket, and optional TCP API) allow 5 seconds for request headers and set a 32 KiB request-header parsing limit; these fixed transport limits do not change the existing per-operation `BOSUN_API_TIMEOUT` behavior
- GitHub webhooks (`/webhook/github`) plus a generic HMAC endpoint (`/webhook`, validates `X-Signature` or `X-Hub-Signature-256`). Webhook auth fails closed: with no `WEBHOOK_SECRET` configured, all HTTP trigger endpoints reject requests with `403` unless `BOSUN_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_WEBHOOK=true` explicitly opts out. The daemon and standalone receiver control-sanitize and cap accepted GitHub pusher names before logs or telemetry. GitLab, Gitea, and Bitbucket are handled by the separate `bosun webhook` receiver, which normalizes each provider and forwards to the daemon's trigger endpoint — do not point them directly at the daemon
- Configurable polling intervals
- Single-flight reconciliation with counted trigger coalescing: triggers received during a run form an atomic follow-up batch with sorted distinct-source attribution and sticky `force`; arrivals during that follow-up form the next batch
- Health endpoints (`/health`, `/ready`)
- Periodic drift detection (declared vs actual state); ignore rules suppress matching alerts without falsely reporting still-active drift as resolved
- Native Discord, SendGrid, and Twilio alerting; Discord embeds are bounded to provider component and aggregate limits, while error/critical Twilio messages are capped at one GSM-7 or Unicode SMS segment
- Deploy state tracking with circuit breaker (stops retrying after 3 failures)
- Post-sync `exec` hooks require a non-empty command; invalid root or per-target hook configuration fails before deployment
- Private HTTPS Git clone and fetch use the paired `BOSUN_GIT_USERNAME`/`BOSUN_GIT_TOKEN` Basic credentials. Both unset preserves anonymous HTTPS; partial pairs, URL userinfo, non-HTTPS URLs, downgrade redirects, and cross-origin redirects fail closed. The pair has no legacy aliases or YAML keys, follows `BOSUN_REPO_URL` precedence, and rotates only after process restart

Self-update's same-release SHA-256 validation is an integrity control, not
independent publisher authentication. Replacing both the archive and
`checksums.txt` remains outside this control, and current releases do not publish
checksum signature assets.

## Project Structure

```
bosun/
├── cmd/bosun/main.go       # Entry point
├── internal/
│   ├── cmd/                # Cobra CLI commands
│   ├── config/             # Configuration loading
│   ├── docker/             # Docker SDK wrapper
│   ├── manifest/           # YAML rendering engine
│   ├── reconcile/          # GitOps engine
│   └── ui/                 # Colored console output
├── manifest/               # Service definitions
│   ├── provisions/         # Reusable config templates
│   ├── services/           # Service manifests
│   └── stacks/             # Stack definitions
├── site/                   # Astro docs site (GitHub Pages via pages.yml)
└── docs/                   # Documentation
    └── diagrams/           # Dual-layer: .mmd (bot/ASCII) + .html/.svg (editorial)
```

The docs site is published at https://cameronsjo.github.io/bosun/ by
`.github/workflows/pages.yml` (build-only on PRs, build+deploy on main push).
Rolling back a bad deploy means reverting on `main` — the `github-pages`
environment is main-only, so re-running the workflow against an older ref is
rejected at the deploy step. Editorial diagram exports embed their source
`.mmd` sha256; `make diagrams-check` fails CI when an export goes stale or
when an exported SVG carries active content.

## Technology Stack

- Go 1.25+
- Docker + Docker Compose v2
- SOPS + Age (secret encryption)
- Go text/template + Sprig (templating)
- Cobra (CLI framework)
